description: This file defines the CatalogContext class, which is a DbContext for Entity Framework Core used in the Data layer of the eShopOnWeb project. It maps entity classes like Basket, CatalogItem, CatalogBrand, CatalogType, Order, OrderItem, and BasketItem to database tables and configures the model using configurations from the assembly.

classes.name: CatalogContext
classes.description: A DbContext subclass representing the database context for catalog-related entities in the eShopOnWeb infrastructure layer.

methods.name: CatalogContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DbContext with given options.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Override to apply configurations from the current assembly to the model.
